title: ScoutClaw configuration
description: ~/.scout/config.json (global), .scout/config.json (shared project) or .scout/config.local.json (personal project). API keys are never read from these files.

baseUrl.description: Alternative Responses API endpoint. Only read from the global file.

approval.description: ask: prompt for medium and high risk; edits: also run workspace file edits without asking; auto: run medium risk without asking; readonly: deny anything that is not low risk. auto and edits in a shared project file apply only once the project is trusted.

maxOutput.description: Bytes of tool output kept per call.

maxRead.description: Bytes of file content fs_read may return per call.

compactAt.description: Conversation size in tokens at which the provider compacts earlier turns; 0 turns it off, otherwise at least 20000.

instructions.description: Extra instruction files (relative to the project root) added to the model's context. In a shared project file they apply only once the project is trusted.

permissions.description: Rules: Tool or Tool(spec). fs_* take a path glob relative to the project root, shell_exec/proc_start a command (' *' = any further arguments), net_* domain:host. deny wins over ask, ask over allow.

allow.description: Run without asking. In the shared project file: only once trusted, and never for high-risk actions.

ask.description: Always ask, even in auto or edits mode.

additionalDirectories.description: Extra directories treated as part of the workspace (writable after approval).
